signals.note: synthetic steady clock; no audio is faked

wauVisualization.note: W/A/U lanes are composited into the rendered RGB for display only: rgb += w*[1,0.92,0.75] + a*[1,0.55,0.10] + u*[0.45,0,1], clamped to [0,1]. All manifest metrics are measured on the raw six-lane output BEFORE this mapping.

items.label: Vintage White
items.identity: Slams every vintage filament head's W channel to full, with the fire-sync release ramp on exit — the ship's 1912 signature flash.
items.reason: Unique hardware identity; fire-sync depends on it.

items.label: Blast White
items.identity: Every channel of every pixel to full white — the photo-moment crowd-hit slam.
items.reason: The rig's one honest full-white; release envelope already generalized.

items.label: UV Blast
items.identity: U channel to full across the rig — blacklight bath.
items.reason: Only UV gesture in the system.

items.label: Fogger
items.identity: DMX relay to the haze machines; no pixel output.
items.reason: Hardware relay, not a pixel effect.

items.label: 2 Hz Pulse
items.identity: The same gate at 2 Hz.
items.reason: A mode-wheel position, not a library identity (docs/74 §4.2).

items.label: 4 Hz Sync
items.identity: Frame-locked full-rig gate at 4 Hz — the canonical strobe.
items.reason: Becomes THE Strobe entry; the Frequency mode wheel walks 2/4/5/10/20 Hz from here.

items.label: 5 Hz Punch
items.identity: The same gate at 5 Hz.
items.reason: Mode-wheel position (docs/74 §4.2).

items.label: 10 Hz Hard
items.identity: The same gate at 10 Hz.
items.reason: Mode-wheel position; WARNING tier travels with the mode value.

items.label: 20 Hz Max
items.identity: The same gate at 20 Hz — a two-frame cycle at 40 fps.
items.reason: Stays reachable as the wheel's expert stop, never a default tile (docs/74 D16).

items.label: White Flash
items.identity: 400 ms additive white+W pop — the hand-drummed boom primitive.
items.reason: Distinct envelope and colour; the VSN1 drum voice.

items.label: Iceberg Flash
items.identity: Icy cyan pop with UV and a longer 500 ms ring-out.
items.reason: Genuinely different colour story and tail.

items.label: Vintage Burst
items.identity: Amber flash that lights the vintage heads and rings 600 ms.
items.reason: The warm boom; pairs with the vintageWhite identity.

items.label: Ocean Blue
items.identity: 70 % lerp of the whole rig toward deep blue.
items.reason: Frozen paint in a palette-driven system; superseded by the palette-fed wash (docs/74 E1). Not a visual dupe — the kill is architectural.

items.label: Iceberg Cyan
items.identity: 75 % lerp toward pale cyan.
items.reason: Same story as ocean_blue; superseded by E1.

items.label: Emergency Red
items.identity: 90 % takeover toward red — the alarm look.
items.reason: Identity fixed by meaning, not taste; a show cue.

items.label: Vintage Amber
items.identity: 65 % tint toward amber with a W+A lift — the 1912 grade.
items.reason: Keep the look, rebuild as a true luma-preserving grade (docs/74 E4); today it brightens as it tints.

items.label: Purple
items.identity: 75 % tint toward violet.
items.reason: 'A colour I like' is what the wheel + E1 are for.

items.label: Invert
items.identity: 1−v on the RGB of the whole frame; W/A/U protected.
items.reason: Cheap, striking, safety-clean chroma op.

items.label: Soft Afterimage
items.identity: Short additive comet tails (decay .88).
items.reason: The everyday trails.

items.label: Ghost Ship
items.identity: Replace-blend memory with heavy colour bleed — the ship dissolves into its own after-image.
items.reason: Distinct blend mode, distinct look.

items.label: Long Afterimage
items.identity: The same additive tails, longer (decay .96).
items.reason: Identical mechanism and blend; length becomes the mode wheel (short/long).

items.label: Cosmic Trails
items.identity: Max-blend trails with bleed — light accumulates without darkening.
items.reason: Overlap matrix separates it from ghost_ship (RMS 24.6, well clear of the near-dupe band).

items.label: Soft Pump
items.identity: Whole-rig luminance duck on the beat, 35 %.
items.reason: Becomes THE Beat Pump; depth is already the jog.

items.label: Deep Pump
items.identity: The same duck at 60 %.
items.reason: A preset that only moves the jog's default is not a second effect.

items.label: Half-Time
items.identity: The same duck at half tempo.
items.reason: rate (0.5/1/2) becomes the mode wheel.

items.label: Every Other - Repeat
items.identity: Two palette colours alternate pixel-by-pixel and walk forward, both stepping through the palette.
items.reason: 2 COLOUR walk — core identity.

items.label: Every Other - Reverse
items.identity: The same alternating pair, ping-pong travel.
items.reason: Direction is a mode, not a tile (docs/74 §6.2).

items.label: Every Other - Two Tone
items.identity: Two colours, no dark gaps — the docs/71 two-tone look in motion.
items.reason: Denser, calmer read at 50 ft; earns its tile as TWO TONE.

items.label: One Per Colour - Repeat
items.identity: All five palette colours laid as a ladder along every group, crawling.
items.reason: 5 COLOUR walk — the flagship.

items.label: One Per Colour - Reverse
items.identity: The same ladder, ping-pong.
items.reason: Direction mode.

items.label: Pulse - Burst then Long Fade
items.identity: Whole-palette burst, then a 5 s fall to almost-out — the ship breathes its colours.
items.reason: Unique envelope; tile 1 of the colour family.

items.label: One Colour At A Time
items.identity: Each group holds ONE colour; colours march group-by-group across the ship.
items.reason: The boldest of the family; only mode that reads on 1–2-pixel groups.

items.label: One Colour At A Time - Reverse
items.identity: The same march, ping-pong.
items.reason: Direction mode.

items.label: One Per Colour - Double Time
items.identity: The same ladder at 2 px/beat.
items.reason: Speed is a mode stop (×1/×2), not an identity.

items.label: Rising Tide
items.identity: Soft blue band climbing the hull, four seconds per pass.
items.reason: The ship's identity move — the tide.

items.label: Beat Wipe
items.identity: The same soft band, marginally narrower, synced per beat.
items.reason: Differs by width .05 and the sync flag; its own speedHz is dead code when synced. The HARD wipe the name promises is docs/74 E15.

items.label: Shadow Pass
items.identity: A moving band of DARKNESS drifting across the ship.
items.reason: The only darken-mode spatial gesture in the library.

items.label: Punch
items.audioNote: Rendered as the MANUAL trigger (three fires). The toggle auto-router is kick-driven and inert with zero audio — not faked here.
items.identity: Auto-fires white drop-hits off the live kick signal (threshold + rate limit).
items.reason: A different instrument from dropHit — the music plays the drum. Inert without audio; surfaces must say so (docs/74 F5).

items.label: Ice Punch
items.audioNote: Rendered as the MANUAL trigger (three fires). The toggle auto-router is kick-driven and inert with zero audio — not faked here.
items.identity: The same router in icy cyan.
items.reason: Colour should follow palette B instead of a frozen cyan (docs/74 D9).

items.label: Hold
items.identity: Captures the frame and holds it until released.
items.reason: The DJ's stop-time.

items.label: Fade 2s
items.identity: Holds, then lets the live show bleed back over two seconds.
items.reason: Distinct, musical exit.

items.label: Stutter
items.identity: Byte-identical params to hold; there is no stutter code anywhere in the engine.
items.reason: A duplicate wearing a lie for a name (global_effect_library.js:521). The real stutter ships in docs/74 E14.

items.label: 2-level
items.identity: RGB posterize to 2 levels — woodcut poster look.
items.reason: Becomes THE Palette Crush entry.

items.label: 4-level
items.identity: Posterize to 4 levels.
items.reason: levels becomes the mode wheel (2/4/6); amount is already the jog.

items.label: 6-level soft
items.identity: Posterize to 6 levels at 60 %.
items.reason: Mode-wheel position.

items.label: Calm 8s
items.identity: 8-second whole-rig swell, ±35 %.
items.reason: The ambient idle-breathing gesture; tempo-locks to 4 bars.

items.label: Deep 14s
items.identity: 14-second swell, ±50 %.
items.reason: Depth is the jog; period folds into the mode wheel.

items.label: Sunrise
items.identity: 20-second swell that WARMS (W/A lift) as it rises.
items.reason: The warmth curve is a real second identity, not a knob position.

items.label: Fizz
items.identity: Sparse white glints (1 % of pixels, 400 ms decay) on the W channel — frost.
items.reason: Signature overlay; cheap.

items.label: Blizzard
items.identity: 15 % of the rig glinting at 80 ms — a white-noise blizzard.
items.reason: Reads as noise and spikes W power (gallery: peak ×2.39, 88 % of pixels); retune density toward ~0.06 (docs/74 D8).

items.label: Hi-Hat
items.audioNote: density 0 + audioDensity true: every glint comes from live micHigh. With no audio there is no manual equivalent, so this renders inert by design.
items.identity: Glint density rides the live hi-hat band; zero glints without audio.
items.reason: The only audio-textured overlay; label the audio dependency on every surface (it is correctly dead in silence).
